meta.source: ReplayGate feedstock harvest at the user's tap 2026-11-05 -- three parallel sweeps: (a) Axiom Math lab announcements and repos; (b) the four Lean candidates cut by the 10-cap in the 2026-11-02 harvest plus its two AxiomProver near-misses, re-checked; (c) arXiv "Lean" listing sweep 2026-10-20..2026-11-05 (172 API entries screened). All arXiv IDs verified on their abs pages or via the arXiv API; all repos verified live via the GitHub API (metadata and trees only, no clones, no builds, per the loop's boundaries). Recon method: Grandmaster's Methods at recon (what the artifact's architecture actually does, weighted to process evidence over announcement prose), M1-M4 seams recorded per claim in code_note, Stellar BB6 non-vacuity vectors noted where the scope applies (agent-rewritten Challenge/Solution statements: factoring, RiemannJensen, CFSG corollary, Dedekind), DEEPEN run as the pre-registration challenge pass on the draft shortlist (its findings are folded into the notes: comparator config is not a comparator run; repo file counts are inflated by vendored trees where flagged; squashed single-commit histories are provenance, not defects). Purpose: candidates whose audit artifacts a ReplayGate-checked audit note can actually be written against. No verdicts in this run. Dedup: Axiom CFSG itself was already registered in harvest 2026-10-27 (unpicked, still in queue) and is NOT re-registered here; OpenAI ETH and Anthropic ETH are audited closed; the toric-code paper arXiv:2611.03329 stays WATCH-only (registered with the Monday scan 2026-11-05, no Lean files public yet). WATCH registrations (formalization claimed, no public artifact location verified as of 2026-11-05; availability trigger only): arXiv:2611.06562 (Mortality undecidable for 2x2 integer matrices, Lean companion claimed, no link on the abs page) and arXiv:2610.37899 (hierarchical laminates counterexample, "formally verified in Lean 4" in the comments, no location). Out of window, not registered: arXiv:2609.33842 (Hamilton-Perelman Poincare formalization, submitted 2026-09-27, artifact pinned at release v0.1.3 commit 7a48598d in github.com/qinz1yang/differential-geometry) -- flag for a future window decision, do not silently absorb. Cut by the cap, held for the next run if still fresh: 2611.06325 (third Brauer-Thrall, Enomoto, 1,201-file tree), 2610.30655 (Euler non-uniqueness Part I, Coiculescu), 2611.05146 (path decompositions, Gaspers, Zenodo), 2611.04934 (contract design polymatroids, 74 files), 2611.04862 (Douglas conjecture Kronecker quivers, 738-file tree), 2611.04806 (minimax lower bounds, ancillary Lean), 2611.01064 (two-deletion channel entropy, single-file Lean checker), 2610.40592 (toric CSS decoupling, 780-file tree; distinct from the 2611.03329 watch item), 2610.40585 (quantum channel additivity, no toolchain pin found), 2610.39883 (pure semisimplicity counterexample, 161 files), 2610.38913 (Maxwell universality, v2 adds Lean records), 2610.42124 (first-passage percolation, 990-file tree), 2611.00153 (small universal reversible TMs, 336 files), 2611.00451 (free Banach lattices, 12 files), 2610.34580 (Bloch-Landau constant, Zenodo), 2610.27451 (rank-23 3x3 scheme, Zenodo), 2611.06616 (LeanVOA library release, library not a single claim).
